name: Anxinzhuan
tagline: Offline speech-to-text with batch audio and video transcription
description: Anxinzhuan is an offline speech-to-text application for Windows, macOS, Linux and Android. It transcribes audio and video locally with batch imports, automatic queues, timestamps and speaker labels. It helps prepare meeting notes, interview transcripts, course notes and subtitle drafts while keeping media and transcripts on the user’s own device. Downloads and documentation, including local MCP integration, are available on the official website.
